questions.stem: A 65-year-old post-menopausal woman came to Gyneac OPD with complaints of spotting. On TVS and then further endometrial biopsy revealed endometrial carcinoma. On imaging the adjacent organs and Lymph nodes have been metastasized. the anal canal is involved due to common lymph drainage of the anal canal and corneal end of the uterus through the round ligament which is the superficial inguinal nodes. So for dissecting the anal ischioanal fossa, which of the following statements is correct about its boundary?

options.label: A
options.text: Sacrotuberous muscle forms the anterior boundary

options.label: B
options.text: A perineal membrane forms the posterior boundary

options.label: C
options.text: The Gluteus maximus muscle forms the posterior boundary

options.label: D
options.text: The ischial tuberosity is the medial boundary
